name: review-driven-development
description: Review-driven development: write every commit as a Conventional Commit (conventional-commits), optimize a finished plan against client-side architecture and naming best practices before any code exists (blueprint), make a large change readable by curating its history into a bottom-up narrative (split-pr), execute the plan to completion with parallel subagent waves and a closeout review gate (sprint), answer review comments one class at a time and reply in one sentence (fix-comment), validate a multi-PR stack structurally (validate-stack), manage the PR chain (stacked-prs), and hand wider audiences a guided-reading deck (pr-deck). Never publishes placeholders a later PR removes.
